jobs.title: IT Talent Pool for C# Developers - M/F/D
jobs.description:
Responsibilities

At Societe Generale, we are one of the leading financial services groups in Europe. With over 150 years of history and a strong international presence, we provide innovative solutions in corporate and investment banking, asset management, and more.

We are currently expanding our operations in Warsaw, where we're building a new Global Solution Centre (GSC) to serve the entire EMEA region. One of the cornerstones of this transformation is the creation of a new IT Hub, with a strong focus on technology, innovation, and engineering excellence. Since 2024, we’ve launched 7 C# development teams, and we’re not stopping — more teams are being built, and existing ones are growing fast.Our C# developers focus primarily on backend development, with only a small portion involving frontend work and limited web development. Many of our systems are designed for internal use by our front-, middle-, and back-office teams. The tech stack varies between teams, depending on the business use case and architecture of the solutions.

Even if we don't have the perfect role for you right now, by joining our C# Talent Pool, you’ll be among the first to know about new opportunities. Our teams are growing rapidly, and new projects and positions are opening every month. Interested in shaping the future of tech in investment banking?

Apply now and let’s build it together!

Why join our C# Talent Pool?

Shape the Future – Join us during a key growth phase and have real influence over the technical direction and culture of our teams.
Ownership Culture – We embrace a “you build it – you run it” philosophy that empowers engineers and promotes accountability.
Tech-Driven Challenges – Work on performance-critical, complex systems supporting global financial operations.
Exposure to Investment Banking – Get hands-on experience with the tools and products used across various areas of investment banking.
Global Collaboration – Engage daily with international teams and stakeholders from across the globe.
Truly International Environment – Be part of a multicultural Warsaw-based team, with English as our working language.

Your future scope of responsibility will cover:

Building, delivering, and running the application, using Craftsmanship best practices.
Developing and supporting features in a functional applicative chain.
Providing production support for existing application features.
Proposing recommendations for process improvement.
Giving clear and consistent reports to the clients and management.
Writing unit tests and reviewing the code to be delivered.
Performing non-regression tests.

Required

Profile required

You will be best suited for this role if:

You have strong C# skills – years of experience matter less than your expertise.
You are familiar with Agile methodologies, TDD, and CI/CD.
You communicate in English with ease.
You enjoy working in a team and eagerly share knowledge.
Please note this posting is a part of an ongoing hiring process, designed to fill multiple openings over time. If you will be selected for an active recruitment process, you will be contacted, and, upon agreement, placed to the unique requisition. If you are already looking for a specific position, please look at the SG career site for opportunities best suitable for your skillset and interests.
Please be informed that we will be accepting only resumes in English.

Why join us

Your future with Societe Generale will include:

Work in a pleasant atmosphere as part of an international team in a brand-new office in the center of Warsaw, designed with facilities for people with disabilities
An active role in an international structure and the opportunity for growth
Access to educational platforms and language courses
Stability
Competitive salary based on seniority and skills
Support in quick adaptation in the company
Extraordinary health package with extensive dental care
Hybrid work (2 or 3 days per week) and one-time bonus for home office equipment
Even more benefits such as meal allowance, holiday fund, sports card and insurance.

Business insight

At Societe Generale, we are convinced that people are drivers of change, and that the world of tomorrow will be shaped by all their initiatives, from the smallest to the most ambitious.

Whether you’re joining us for a period of months, years or your entire career, together we can have a positive impact on the future. Creating, daring, innovating and taking action are part of our DNA.

If you too want to be directly involved, grow in a stimulating and caring environment, feel useful on a daily basis and develop or strengthen your expertise, you will feel right at home with us!

Still hesitating?

You should know that our employees can dedicate several days per year to solidarity actions during their working hours, including sponsoring people struggling with their orientation or professional integration, participating in the financial education of young apprentices, and sharing their skills with charities. There are many ways to get involved.

The position entails working in an international environment, including close collaboration with stakeholders across France, Poland, Romania and India, ensuring high-quality software delivery while fostering team growth and performance.

Your future scope of responsibility will cover:

People & Team Management
(key focus)

Leading and managing a team of C# developers through supporting team members in their professional development and career progression. Driving performance management, while promoting a culture of high‑quality collaboration across the organization

Acting as a key point of contact for the team for interactions with business stakeholders and global counterparts

Development & Delivery

Contributing to code reviews, troubleshooting, handling technical escalations and ensuring critical deliveries

Required

Profile required

You have a deep and complex understanding of relational databases and backend architecture, along with exposure to frontend technologies to support end‑to‑end solution delivery
You have proven experience managing the full SDLC and development activities

You demonstrate strong leadership, communication, and organizational skills

jobs.title: Software Development Consultant (early career)
jobs.description:
Are you looking to grow not only as a software developer, but also as a trusted advisor? At Columbia Road, we're looking for talented developers to help businesses grow while you grow your career. If you've already gained some hands-on experience in professional software development and are eager to grow into a skilled consultant in a low-hierarchy, supportive environment, we would love to hear from you. Let’s find your Road!

TLDR

Role: Software Developer (Associate Consultant or Consultant)
Focus: Help businesses grow by building and improving digital sales channels and systems for our clients.
Environment: Low-hierarchy, supportive, community-led, with an emphasis on transparency and trust.
Team: Varying teams built around each individual client’s need. Cross-competence collaboration.
Ideal Candidate: A couple years of professional web development (full-stack) experience, eager to learn and make an impact. The position is also suitable for someone finishing their studies. Fluent in English and Finnish.
Location: Helsinki or Tampere, no visa sponsorships offered.
Salary & benefits: Monthly gross salary 3000-4500€, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. Extensive benefits package, including e.g. comprehensive healthcare insurance, allowance for sports/massage/commuting and compensation for doing social good & open source projects to name a few.

Who we are

Columbia Road is the go-to consulting partner for businesses that want to sell better. Excelling in both commercial operations and scalable technology, we build seamless and effective customer journeys for measurable impact. In each of our projects, we focus on generating more revenue and more customers for our clients, working in cross-competence teams made up of the brightest minds in digital commerce.

As a community-led company, we believe in giving a lot of responsibility and freedom to our employees. Instead of line managers and red tape, we offer the tools and resources to all Roadies to make the best possible decisions for their own job and for our community. We offer you a diverse and inclusive workplace, and your fellow Roadies will ensure that you’ll feel comfortable from day one.

The job & what you’d be working on

As a software developer, you are interested in what happens under the hood of modern digital sales channels. You’ll get to work together with other Columbia Road consultants in a cross-competence team, building and growing new digital businesses for our customers in various fields of business. This means you may collaborate daily with designers, digital marketers, strategy consultants, data & AI specialists as well as our clients' stakeholders and team. You will be supported in your learning by peers in both development and other domains, and you’ll have the ability to create real impact in our clients’ businesses.

Your motivation comes from the results and impact your solution creates, rather than the technical beauty of the code. For us, technology is a tool to create business impact for our clients, and we are agnostic in choosing whichever tools best solve the challenge. This can mean widely used programming languages and frameworks, but also different CRM, CMS and ecommerce solutions that we customise and integrate to our clients’ other systems. We have listed some examples further below.

If you're looking for a workplace where you get a lot of responsibility and where you get to learn new things fast from more experienced peers, you'll find it here. You will get to grow with us, nurture your own ambitions and learn new skills within digital sales.

This position is a great fit for you if

You are a student in the final year of your studies, or have graduated within the past couple of years.
You have already gained professional work experience related to software development. For example, you may have worked part time in a professional setting during your studies.
You have a good understanding of the basic principles of both backend and frontend software development.
You’re agnostic in your tech-approach and are open to using a wide array of languages, frameworks, CRM and CMS systems and ecommerce platforms, selecting the tools that best match our clients’ needs.
Some of the most common languages we come across in our work are JavaScript, Typescript, PHP, Java and C#. We hope you are comfortable with more than one of these.
Other technologies seen as an advantage include: Clojure, Scala, Python, Go as well as any experience working with CMS, CRM and ecommerce platforms.
You are self-driven, proactive and want to continuously learn new things.
You understand the basics of digitalisation and you approach problems in an analytical manner.
You would love to work with challenging client cases supported by a diverse community of digital sales professionals.
You are comfortable communicating matters related to your own work and you enjoy working with other people in an agile environment – it’s not a problem for you to present your own ideas to a small group of people from time to time, for example in a workshop.
You have a “get things done” attitude towards your work.
You live (or plan to move) within commuting distance of Helsinki or Tampere and are open to working on-site according to client needs.
You are fluent in English and Finnish.

Recruitment process

Our recruitment process typically involves 2-3 interviews where we learn about your skills and what motivates you. You'll discover more about Columbia Road and meet various Roadies along the way. After our discussions, we'll reach out to your chosen references.
This is a permanent, full-time position with a flexible start date from August 2026. We hope to hear from you soon!

Benefits

A monthly gross salary of 3000-4500 euros, depending on your experience and stage of potential studies. In addition, we offer extensive benefits:
A community-led organisation with a high level of autonomy
A diverse, equitable, and inclusive workplace
Option to buy stocks of the company through the common employee share program
Recurring training and learning sessions to support your professional growth
Regular mentoring with a Roadie of your own choosing - or several!
Offices in downtown Helsinki (with gym and pool) and Tampere
A wide selection of quality tools to use for your work (laptop, phone etc.)
Extensive health care services, including dental and mental health
Insurance for travel and free-time
Lunch benefit
Phone subscription benefit
Weekly breakfasts and healthy daily refreshments
Flexible sports, culture, commuting and massage benefit
Recurring Roadie-ideated events and activities
Childcare services when your child falls ill
A possibility to book the office for private events during the weekends
Compensation for working on open source or social programs in your free time

We help companies sell better by building seamless digital solutions and running concrete growth activities. Find your Road with us by exploring open jobs or Connecting with us!

jobs.title: D365 Developer
jobs.description:
D365 Commerce / MPOS Developer

Overview
We are looking for an experienced D365 Commerce / MPOS Developer
to join a dynamic retail technology team. In this role, you will be responsible for developing and enhancing Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce solutions, supporting existing retail processes, resolving production issues, and contributing to technical design and architecture.
This is an excellent opportunity to work on large-scale retail transformation initiatives across the full D365 Commerce ecosystem, including POS, Store Commerce App, Headquarters, e-commerce, and integrations.

Key Responsibilities
Design, develop, and implement customizations within Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce
(MPOS / Store Commerce App).
Support, maintain, and enhance both standard and custom retail processes.
Develop solutions across HQ, CRT, POS, Hardware Station, and RTS
.
Troubleshoot, analyze, and resolve production incidents and system issues.
Participate in code upgrades, deployments, and cloud-hosted environment management.
Prepare and maintain Technical Design Documents (TDDs).
Follow development best practices, version control standards, and CI/CD processes.
Collaborate with functional consultants and business stakeholders during solution design workshops.
Ensure solutions are scalable, maintainable, and aligned with Microsoft best practices.
Support unit testing, integration testing, and user acceptance testing activities.
Monitor application performance and recommend improvements related to scalability, reliability, and security.
Stay up to date with the latest D365 Commerce releases and features.
Manage build and release processes for both backend and store-side retail solutions.

Required Skills & Experience
8+ years of overall development experience.
Strong hands-on experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 Commerce / Retail
(MPOS or Store Commerce App).
Solid knowledge of:
X++
C#
.NET
SQL Server
TypeScript
HTML
Experience developing solutions using:
Commerce Runtime (CRT)
POS Extensions
Hardware Station Extensions
Retail Server
Experience with D365 integration frameworks such as:
DMF
OData
Business Events
APIs
Strong understanding of D365 Commerce upgrades, deployments, and cloud-hosted environments.
Experience with Git-based source control and Azure DevOps CI/CD pipelines.
